description: SDMX-JSON 2.2.0 Schema for SDMX 3.2.0 registry messages

$schema.description: Contains the URL to the JSON schema allowing to validate the message. This also allows identifying the version of SDMX-JSON format used in this message. Providing the link to the SDMX-JSON schema is recommended.

meta.description: A meta object that contains non-standard meta-information and basic technical information about the message, such as when it was prepared and who has sent it.

errors.description: Array of statusInformation objects providing - when appropriate - more detail to the HTTP status codes in the RESTful SDMX web service responses.

meta.description: A meta object that contains non-standard meta-information and basic technical information about the message, such as when it was prepared and who has sent it.

schema.description: Deprecated and replaced by the $schema property at the root level, which allows for automated validations.

id.description: Unique string assigned by the sender that identifies the message for further references.

test.description: Test indicates whether the message is for test purposes or not. False for normal messages.

prepared.description: A date or date-time indicating when the message was prepared. Values must follow the ISO 8601 syntax for dates or combined dates and times, including time zone.

contentLanguages.description: Array of strings containing the identifyer of all languages used anywhere in the message for localized elements, and thus the languages of the intended audience, representing in an array format the same information than the http Content-Language response header, e.g. "en, fr-fr". See IETF Language Tags: https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc5646#section-2.1. The array's first element indicates the main language used in the message for localized elements. The usage of this property is recommended.

name.description: Name provides a name for the transmission. Multiple instances allow for parallel language values.

names.description: Name provides a name for the transmission. Multiple instances allow for parallel language values.

sender.description: Sender is information about the party that is transmitting the message.

receivers.description: Receiver is information about the part(y/ies) that is/are the intended recipient(s) of the message. This can be useful if the WS requires authentication.

party.description: Sender contains information about the party that is transmitting the message.

id.description: The id holds the identification of the party.

name.description: Name is a human-readable name of the party.

names.description: Name is a human-readable name of the party.

contacts.description: Contacts provides contact information for the party in regard to the transmission of the message.

statusInformation.description: Used to provide status information with more detail to the HTTP status codes in the RESTful SDMX web service responses.

code.description: Provides an HTTP status code number for the status information if appropriate. See RESTful SDMX web service error handling and status information (https://github.com/sdmx-twg/sdmx-rest/blob/master/doc/status.md).

title.description: A short, human-readable (best-language-match) summary of the situation that SHOULD NOT change from occurrence to occurrence of the status, except for purposes of localization.

titles.description: A list of short, human-readable localised summaries (see *[names](#names)*) of the status that SHOULD NOT change from occurrence to occurrence of the status, except for purposes of localization.

detail.description: A human-readable (best-language-match) explanation specific to this occurrence of the status. Like title, this field’s value can be localized. It is fully customizable by the service providers and should provide enough detail to ease understanding the reasons of the status.

details.description: A list of human-readable localised explanations (see *[names](#names)*) specific to this occurrence of the status. Like titles, this field’s value can be localized. It is fully customizable by the service providers and should provide enough detail to ease understanding the reasons of the status.

links.description: If appropriate, a collection of links to additional external resources for the status information.
Links field is an array of link objects. If appropriate, a collection of links to additional external resources for the header.

rel.description: Relationship of the object to the resource. The value is prefixed with the source of its semantics: sdmx for SDMX artefact types (e.g. sdmx:dataStructure), rfc for the link relation types of RFC 8288 (e.g. rfc:alternate, rfc:help), misc for miscellaneous types (e.g. misc:calendar, misc:source), skos for SKOS relationships (e.g. skos:exactMatch), xkos for XKOS relationships (e.g. xkos:generalizes), and x for custom extensions (e.g. x:catalog). The relationship rfc:self should not be used for SDMX artefacts, as this is already expressed in their urn.

anyOf.description: Deprecated since SDMX 3.2. Unprefixed relationship values, use the corresponding prefixed values instead. structure: provides a reference to the data structure or metadata structure definition depending on the context. Other SDMX artefact types can be specified, e.g. dataflow, provisionagreement, etc. For the others please see: https://tools.ietf.org/rfc/rfc5988.txt

Predefined prefixed relationship values: SDMX artefact types (sdmx), RFC 8288 link relation types (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8288) (rfc), misc:calendar (link to a release calendar), misc:source (information about the source of data), misc:request (the SDMX RESTful query that triggered the response), SKOS (skos) and XKOS (xkos) relationships. Custom relationships use the x prefix.

urn.description: The urn holds any valid SDMX Registry URN (see SDMX Registry Specification for details) or any other URN.

uri.description: Deprecated since SDMX 3.2. The uri attribute holds a URI that contains a link to additional information about the resource, such as a web page. This uri is not an SDMX resource.

title.description: A human-readable (best-language-match) title of the linked resource.

titles.description: Human-readable localised titles of the linked resource. A title must be unique for a given locale.

type.description: A hint about the media type of the representation returned by the link (e.g. application/pdf, text/html). See the list of media types assigned by the IANA.

hreflang.description: Deprecated since SDMX 3.2, use locale instead. The natural language of the external link, the same as used in the HTTP Accept-Language request header.

locale.description: The locale of the linked resource, based on the IETF BCP 47 language tag.

localisedBestMatchText.description: localisedBestMatchText is a reusable element, used for providing a human-readable best-language-match texts.

localisedText.description: localisedText provides for a set of language-specific alternates to be provided for any human-readable constructs in the instance.

contactType.description: ContactType describes the structure of a contact's details.

name.description: Name contains a humain-readable name for the contact.

names.description: Name contains a humain-readable name for the contact.

department.description: Department is a humain-readable designation of the organisational structure by a linguistic expression, within which the contact person works.

departments.description: Department is a humain-readable designation of the organisational structure by a linguistic expression, within which the contact person works.

role.description: Role is the humain-readable responsibility of the contact person with respect to the object for which this person is the contact.

roles.description: Role is the humain-readable responsibility of the contact person with respect to the object for which this person is the contact.

items.description: Telephone holds the telephone number for the contact person.
Fax holds the fax number for the contact person.
X400 holds the X.400 address for the contact person.
URI holds an information URL for the contact person.
Email holds the email address for the contact person.

idType.description: IDType provides a type which is used for restricting the characters in codes and IDs throughout all SDMX-ML messages. Valid characters include A-Z, a-z, @, 0-9, _, -, $. Regex: [A-Za-z0-9_@$-]+

specificationExtensions.$comment: While the SDMX-JSON Specification tries to accommodate most use cases, additional data can be added to extend the specification at certain points. The extensions properties are implemented as patterned fields that are always prefixed by x-. Extensions are one of the best ways to prove the viability of proposed additions to the specification. It is therefore RECOMMENDED that implementations be designed for extensibility to support community experimentation. Support for any one extension is OPTIONAL, and support for one extension does not imply support for others.

RegistrationType.description: RegistrationType provides the information needed for a data registration: the provision agreement that the data are registered against and the data source from which the registered data can be retrieved.

id.description: Registry assigned identification for the registration. It must be provided in a response message (unless an error occurred while submitting a new registration), and should be included when updating or deleting a registration.

lastUpdated.description: Timestamp for the last time the data source was updated.

provisionAgreement.description: Urn reference to the provision agreement that the data are registered against.

datasource.description: The data source from which the registered data can be retrieved.

DataSourceType.description: DataSourceType specifies a data source. A file, an SDMX REST API, or both must be specified.

file.description: The URL of an SDMX data message accessible as a file (simple data source).

sdmxApi.description: A web service compliant with the SDMX REST API, from which the registered data can be queried (queryable data source).

SdmxApiType.description: SdmxApiType describes a web service compliant with the SDMX REST API (queryable data source).

entryPoint.description: The URL of the entry point of the SDMX REST web service (e.g. https://sdmx.example.org/rest). It cannot be empty.

sdmxApiVersion.description: The version of the SDMX REST API implemented by the entry point, which determines the syntax of the queries.

SdmxApiVersionType.description: A simple type for the version of the SDMX REST API implemented by a web service. It is given by the code of a release of the SDMX REST API, written as major.minor, without the leading "v" and the patch number (e.g. 1.5, 2.1 or 2.2, from the releases v1.5.0, v2.1.0 and v2.2.2).

ProvisionAgreementReferenceType.description: ProvisionAgreementReferenceType is a type for referencing a provision agreement. It consists of a URN.
